prompt: Photorealistic poster of a diverse group of Kenyan friends of different genders celebrating together outdoors, candid real photograph style, golden hour light, include a headline

plan.rationale: The poster aims to celebrate diversity and unity among Kenyan friends in a candid, real photograph style, capturing the essence of a warm, golden hour. The photograph will feature a diverse group of friends, emphasizing inclusivity and camaraderie. The headline will be concise and impactful, reflecting the celebratory mood of the gathering.
